lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular, with narrower intervals in the mid-section and wider spacing toward the posterior flank.

lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 3, 5, and 11 exhibit discontinuities, terminating mid-flank without reaching the ventral fringe or the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of approximately 4-5 white spots is visible on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, diverging laterally from the base before curving medially and upward toward the tips.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory tipping is visible, occupying approximately 15-20% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white chevron is visible across the bridge of the nose between the eyes, along with distinct white spotting on the lower cheeks.
